changelog:
**Major update: Universalizes and modernizes the skill publishing guide, focusing on cross-platform support and actionable checklists.**

- Fully rewritten as a universal publishing guide (English language, cross-agent scope)
- Condensed pre-publish checklist with emphasis on anti-duplicate checks, no secrets, and proper YAML frontmatter
- Stronger naming conventions and simplified suffix table
- Provides templated SKILL.md and recommended usage of PayPal/GitHub links
- Expands on where/how to publish and post-publish validation steps
- Removes Polish content, platform-specific quirks, and outdated repository/status lists
